newsitem.title: JAPAN: Toshiba plans desktop PC sales outside of Japan.
newsitem.headline: Toshiba plans desktop PC sales outside of Japan.

text.p: Toshiba Corp said on Tuesday it plans to sell desktop personal computers (PCs) outside of Japan.
Toshiba, which is already selling desktop PCs in Japan, will start sales outside Japan by introducing desktop PCs in the United States, a Toshiba spokesman said.
He did not elaborate further on the planned sales but added that Toshiba plans to hold a news conference in New York at 1430 GMT on Tuesday, the spokesman said.
Toshiba is already selling laptop PCs worldwide, capturing the biggest market share, the spokesman said. Toshiba has a 5.9 percent share of the desktop PC market in Japan, he added.
